title: Geonet's countries: res/geonet/countries.json
description: Member 18 of ARCID_GEONET_PLACE (a/0/5/2, NARC_GEONET_PLACE_COUNTRIES in geonet.c): where each country is on the globe, a GeonetCountryPlace by the country's number, which Geonet_LoadPlaces reads; the first isn't a place. tools/data/geonet_place_data.py packs it.

name.description: The country's name, its message of the countries' text bank (sSubdividedCountries[0]'s in country_region.c, res/text/system/event_mapchange_load_country_to_strbuf.txt) by ID, in the same order, or null past its last; the packer checks it and doesn't pack it

state.description: GeonetCountryPlace.state: Geonet_LoadPlaces leaves a country of 2 out, as its regions stand for it

x.description: The globe's turn about its X axis that brings the country to the front (Geonet_AddPlace), in 65536ths of a turn

y.description: The globe's turn about its Y axis, in 65536ths of a turn
